title: Make My Photo Reel Fun
tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: The eight-second vertical reel has a cheerful pastel scrapbook treatment and recognizable subjects, though the shocked cat cannot be verified in the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
must_haves.why: One MP4 is reported as eight seconds long, and its supplied frames are vertical.

must_haves.item: All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
must_haves.why: The dog, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake are visible. The cat is not shown in the sampled frames, but could appear between them.

must_haves.item: The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
must_haves.why: Sparkle overlays, tilted photo frames and colorful torn-paper scrapbook layers provide a visibly playful treatment; motion timing cannot be assessed from still frames.

must_haves.item: Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
must_haves.why: The visible dog and human faces are clear and unobstructed, and the dog and beach friends remain recognizable against their supplied originals.

must_haves.item: The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.
must_haves.why: The frames show successive subjects within one eight-second MP4, with a consistent scrapbook visual style.
